title: ASCII Kinesis V2 Locomotion 006 — Stride-Phase Airborne Handoff
principle: TAKEOFF AND LANDING ARE SUPPORT-OWNERSHIP HANDOFFS INSIDE CONTINUOUS ROOT TRAVEL. The takeoff foot remains causal until release; the reaching landing foot does not own the root until contact; landing support acquires the root before inherited forward travel is fully paid.
minimal_maximal_unit: one approach-support → coil → toe release → ballistic travel → landing probe → catch → absorb → recovery chain

source.identity: Mario & Luigi — Super Mario Bros. 3 — NES — asset 4230
source.whole_sheet_evidence: The entire TSR asset was treated as one evidence corpus, not a cherry-picked animation. TSR identifies the 522x1878 sheet as the playable-character Mario & Luigi sheet and exposes locomotion families including Mario Run, Mario Walk, Super Mario Run, and Super Mario Walk; the whole sheet also contains the broader playable-character pose inventory. Extraction is limited to general support/travel principles visible across the sheet; no cell geometry is copied.
source.rights_boundary: Copyright-restricted commercial-game sprite art used as study evidence only. No source pixels, palette, contours, costume, character proportions, sheet layout, frame arrangement, tracing, redistribution, or close imitation is embedded. Every pose, joint coordinate, ASCII mark, contact state, root path, timing choice, transition, and video frame is independently authored abstract rig data.

OBSERVED: TSR identifies asset 4230 as Mario & Luigi from the NES game Super Mario Bros. 3 and gives the sheet size as 522x1878 PNG.
TSR exposes distinct walk and run animation families for both small and Super Mario forms, establishing that the sheet contains meaningful body travel/locomotion evidence.
The static TSR sheet/page does not establish source-authentic decisive-key exposure timing.
INFERRED: The abstract support-ownership handoff chain from planted takeoff to airborne travel to landing catch/absorption/recovery.
All authored root coordinates, spacing, limb geometry, weight-transfer interpretation, causal state labels, and ONES/TWOS/FOURS assignments.
The use of a left landing catch after a right takeoff support as a general gait-phase continuity model.
UNKNOWN: Source-authentic exposure cadence, exact engine root coordinates, exact chronology between every sheet cell, exact source force distribution, and any timing not explicitly exposed by TSR.

rig.source_independence: All joint coordinates and topology are abstract authored values; no sprite-cell coordinates were imported.

timing_note: ONES/TWOS/FOURS are runner-frame hold classes, never seconds. Every decisive timing here is INFERRED because the static source evidence does not establish exposure timing.

keys.name: APPROACH_R_SUPPORT
keys.causal_role: established travel with right support owning root
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Enter with readable stride lean; right foot is trustworthy support.

keys.name: LOAD_R_COIL
keys.causal_role: anticipation and compression over same support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis drops and advances over the planted right foot: visible anticipation with cost.

keys.name: TOE_RELEASE_R
keys.causal_role: last supported extension before airborne ownership ends
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root rises from the same support; right toe is still the final causal contact.

keys.name: AIR_RISE
keys.causal_role: airborne rise with inherited forward travel
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Support is gone only after release; root continues forward/upward on inherited trajectory.

keys.name: APEX_COMPACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Peak height compresses limbs without changing airborne ownership.

keys.name: DESCENT_L_REACH
keys.causal_role: descent reach; left foot probes but has not yet earned support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Left leg extends toward ground while contact remains explicitly absent; reach is not support.

keys.name: CATCH_L
keys.causal_role: left landing catch; support acquired while root still carries travel
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Left foot earns support; root does not stop at contact and keeps traveling forward.

keys.name: ABSORB_L
keys.causal_role: landing absorption; root continues past catch while pelvis drops
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis drops behind/over the same left support while spacing shrinks: landing load is paid.

keys.name: RECOVER_L
keys.causal_role: recovery; root rises and continues with left support still truthful
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis re-stacks upward while left support remains truthful; recovery costs time before next stride.

compile.connective_policy: Fail-closed authored-key cuts only. No synthetic inbetween is emitted because support ownership, contact truth, root trajectory phase, or causal state changes at decisive boundaries. Repeated frames express explicit holds; all visible motion comes from authored ASCII keys.
compile.renderer: ASCII-only rasterization of literal pose_rig text plus key/state metadata; no source sprite pixels
compile.media_packaging: embedded data:video/mp4 URI in the SPA is authoritative; standalone MP4 exists only as deterministic reconstruction output
compile.semantic_authority: authored ASCII decisive keys + structured timing

inspection_history.inspect: Rendered 3x3 decisive-key montage from the actual ASCII-rig MP4.
inspection_history.highest_value_visible_defect: K3/K4 airborne silhouettes were too bilateral and K4 read as a generic T-pose tuck; travel intent and carried momentum weakened at the apex.
inspection_history.bounded_correction: Re-authored only K3/K4 arm and leg asymmetry while preserving root coordinates, NO_SUPPORT truth, timing classes, and ballistic state sequence.

inspection_history.inspect: Rerendered the actual MP4 after the K3/K4 asymmetry correction and inspected the complete decisive-key sequence as extracted video frames.
inspection_history.highest_value_visible_defect: No material defect remained: support marks are legible, root arc rises/falls continuously, K5 reach remains NO_SUPPORT, K6 catch visibly acquires left support without stopping root travel, K7 pays landing cost through compression, and K8 recovers before the next stride.
inspection_history.bounded_correction: None; further edits would add detail rather than repair locomotion truth.

taste_function_contempt.TASTE: PASS — the specimen has a specific support-handoff idea rather than a generic jump loop; the asymmetric airborne keys carry direction and intent.
taste_function_contempt.FUNCTION: PASS — takeoff contact, unsupported travel, landing probe, catch, absorption, and recovery are causally readable; root movement does not teleport at either ownership boundary.
taste_function_contempt.CONTEMPT: PASS — no decorative tween sludge, no source-derived costume/silhouette, no fake contact, and no free recovery; the landing visibly costs posture and time.

visible_reasons: K1 lowers and advances the pelvis over the same planted right support, making anticipation/load visible.
K2 keeps right support until the final release key; K3 begins airborne only after that contact is gone.
K5 places the reaching left foot near ground while still explicitly NO_SUPPORT, separating reach from ownership.
K6 acquires left support while the root continues forward; K7 compresses on that same support before K8 re-stacks.
The root path and spacing carry momentum through the full chain, so the motion reads as travel rather than pose swapping.
